in_arabic.name: Nabit
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nabit هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'nabata' meaning to 'strike' or 'beat'. Nabit is an Arabic name for boys, which means intelligent or wise. It can also be interpreted as someone who has the ability to strike or beat in a good way. It is a name that reflects the power of the mind and the intelligence of the individual.
